verdictEs: Faceit para matchmaking competitivo cotidiano: tier free jugable, base masiva, anti-cheat actualizado y queue rápida en la mayoría de regiones. ESEA para ligas estructuradas por temporada con divisiones y promotion/relegation, o si ya tienes una cuenta legacy con historial. Ambas son hoy del mismo dueño (ESL FACEIT Group), pero el foco activo migró a Faceit.
verdictEn: Faceit for day-to-day competitive matchmaking: playable free tier, massive base, up-to-date anti-cheat, and fast queue in most regions. ESEA for structured season leagues with divisions and promotion/relegation, or if you already hold a legacy account with history. Both are now owned by ESL FACEIT Group, but the active focus migrated to Faceit.
